items.text: Life rings are mounted at every ladder and inspected monthly.
Walkways are kept clear of nets, crates, and coiled line.
The harbour log records every vessel movement on the day it happens.

source_citation: Invented for the Fencewalk test suite: Wharf Safety Test Authority, Sample Wharf Bulletin 1 (2026). Contains no real rubric content.
title: Sample Wharf Safety Rubric
